patch_description:
The validation failure has no traceback, but the original implementation has several data-corruption paths: it adds and later merges an `original_index` column, writes asynchronously completed rows using completion order rather than source row identity, changes column layouts during recursion, sorts values, and finally returns an empty column-ordering list. Those behaviors can overwrite rows, detach values from their original columns, and violate the required `(reordered_dataframe, column_orderings)` contract.

This replacement preserves every input row, cell, column, and index. It uses object dtype for mixed values, normalizes values only for scoring, produces valid per-row source-column orderings, and chooses between bounded global and conditional ordering candidates using exact sorted-string LCP Trie reuse scoring.
